The running list of what must be true for a Solution to work, how we tested each assumption, and whether it held. It keeps an Initiative honest about which beliefs are evidence and which are still hope.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Assumption](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [10 Discovery](/system/discovery)
- **Owner:** UX designer and researcher, with the product manager
- **Links to:** Parent: [Initiative](/templates/initiative) via its [Discovery brief](/templates/discovery-brief)

## Template

Use "All" in the Solution column when the assumption is about the problem itself, not one Solution.

Types: desirable (people want it), viable (it moves the goal), feasible (we can build it), usable (people can use it). Test the riskiest first, as cheaply as possible.

| # | Solution | Assumption | Type | Risk (high/med/low) | Test | Result | Status (open / holds / broken) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## DMV example

**Single-trip new driver licenses**

| # | Solution | Assumption | Type | Risk | Test | Result | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | All (the problem itself) | Most repeat trips come from document problems | Viable | High | One-week counter log | 6 of 10 repeat trips were document problems | Holds |
| A2 | B: License Ready Check | Applicants will send photos of documents before a visit | Desirable | High | Concierge test: staff reviewed emailed photos for 25 applicants | 19 of 25 sent photos, 7 issues caught early | Holds |
| A3 | A: Document checklist | A self-serve checklist is enough on its own | Usable | Med | Click-through prototype, 5 applicants | 3 of 5 picked the wrong birth certificate type | Broken |
| A4 | B: License Ready Check | Digital Identity Verification can take pre-visit uploads | Feasible | High | Two-day architect spike | Possible, needs a new intake queue | Holds |

A3 is why staff review is part of License Ready Check and the checklist was dropped.
